items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: I used to ride Caesar, that's all the sax section... You see, that's Marvin Kimmel's wife... I used to bring money for him, for Kimmel to help people

ctx.x: You see, that's Marvin Kimmel's wife. Right. Jeanette's, well we called her Sullivan, but I don't think she, yeah she married to Kimmel then, that's right. So I used to bring money for him, for Kimmel to help people, that girl came from, from, uh, uh, Patschristian, Mississippi. Mm-hmm. And every Sunday, Kimmel had a Buick Roast call, and I had a force on the Dodge call, well I used to drive home every Sunday, and go back on a Monday morning, well I used to ride Caesar, that's all the sax section, and sometimes…
